key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Cordate-ovate to deltate-ovate, entire or 3(–5)-lobed; glabrous or sparsely hairy.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, usually 11–14 mm, ciliate, acuminate.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Usually white, sometimes pink-tinged; about 15–20(–25) mm.

key_traits.label: Key
key_traits.text: Small white flower + 11–14 mm pointed sepals; compare with I. triloba and I. cordatotriloba.
